description: Publishes a new incident report on a status page: title, initial timeline message, start time and per-server impact (`servers`). Optionally link to existing Statuser incidents via `incident_ids` so the report aggregates their data. Add subsequent timeline updates via `status_page_incident_report_update_add`. Monthly quota: `status_page_incident_reports_per_month_limit` — 403 on overflow.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

incident_ids.description: Statuser incidents to link to this report (optional). If set, the report is based on these existing incidents.

initial_message.description: Text of the initial timeline update.

servers.description: Per-server impact at the moment the report is published. Use `status_page_get` to find status-page server ids.

status.description: Per-server impact during the report/update: `not_affected`, `downtime`, `degraded` or `resolved`.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the incident started.

name: status_page_incident_report_publish
title: Publish a new incident report
